verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler and framework, so its programmatic surface is the compiler itself. A hands-on community report says importing the compiler to prerender components and hooking into its preprocessing was trivial, though the same user said the documentation could be improved. The first-party docs in the pack cover a scriptable `sv` CLI (create/add/check) and the component authoring syntax, but none of the cited excerpts document a compiler or programmatic API reference. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the programmatic compiler API (e.g. compile/preprocess reference), evidence that an agent can drive the product end-to-end through that API, any independent corroboration beyond a single comment.
